summary: Complete computable criterion for each specified onto block self-map of a nonempty two-sided irreducible sofic shift to extend into the shift from a containing SFT. All local-rule completions, extension radii and larger containing alphabets are covered. This includes Boyle16.3's mixing case and uses the credited published PRZ2014 separation bound. Separate existence-over-all-maps, CA-stability and arbitrary reducible-sofic classifications are outside the result.
